name: io.github.Nizoka/pdfnative-mcp
description: PDF generation, PDF/A and PDF/UA checks, charts, forms, encryption, PAdES LTV signing. 27 tools.

environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to a sandboxed directory where outputMode='file' may write PDF outputs. When unset, every tool returns base64.

environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in content-addressed response cache directory. SHA-256 keyed, 1h TTL, 256 MiB LRU. Tool output is stored as plaintext at rest. Never cached: encrypt_pdf, decrypt_pdf (so decrypted/protected bytes never linger on disk), add_ltv, timestamp_pdf, update_metadata, sign_pdf with timestamp=true (time- or network-dependent output), and any call with outputMode='file'.

environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Bind to an HTTP port instead of stdio (Streamable HTTP MCP transport, loopback only).

environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the RFC 3161 timestamp authority used by sign_pdf timestamp=true and timestamp_pdf (PAdES B-T / B-LTA). When unset those calls fail with TSA_NOT_CONFIGURED and no network request is made. The server never makes an outbound call except to operator-configured TSA / OCSP / CRL endpoints; tool arguments can never supply a URL.

environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_AUTH
environmentVariables.description: Optional Authorization header value sent to the TSA (e.g. 'Basic …' or 'Bearer …'). Never logged or echoed in error messages.

environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_REVOCATION
environmentVariables.description: 'ocsp', 'crl' or 'ocsp,crl' — enables online OCSP / CRL collection for add_ltv mode='online' (PAdES B-LT). When unset that mode fails with REVOCATION_NOT_CONFIGURED; add_ltv mode='offline' embeds caller-supplied material with zero network access. Requires PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_ALLOWED_HOSTS.

environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allow-list of OCSP / CRL responder hosts ('host', 'host:port' or '*.suffix'). Mandatory when PDFNATIVE_MCP_REVOCATION is set: responder URLs come from untrusted certificates inside the PDF and are fetched only when the host matches (http(s) only, no credentials, no redirects, internal address literals rejected unless listed verbatim). Entries are hostnames: 'host:port' only matches URLs with an explicit non-default port, wildcards cannot carry a port, IDN hosts must be punycode, IPv6 literals in brackets. Address literals only are checked — a listed hostname resolving to an internal address (DNS rebinding) is not detected.

environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout for TSA / OCSP / CRL calls in milliseconds, 1000-120000 (default 10000).
